definition: a series of pictures forming one part of a film
description: A film shoot in a stone quarry, seen from behind a big cinema camera on a rig in the foreground with its monitor turned towards us. Across the pit stand two tall concrete silos with a metal walkway running from them to the rock face. An orange fireball bursts out at the walkway and black smoke rises; a stuntman hanging on a wire swings away from it across the quarry. The metal walkway tears loose and crashes down the rock face, throwing up a huge cloud of pale dust that fills the pit while the camera keeps rolling and crew in yellow high-visibility vests watch from below.
